propositions: Natural fold destroys orphan evidence by retiring and citing orphan-file uuids in the new snapshot while positional skip buries their effects, converting repairable damage into silent permanent loss before the repair window closes.
The fold must exclude un-cited pre-snapshot events from retirement and source_event_uuids citation, anchored to the prior snapshot in the fold set, so orphans remain live and detectable by fsck.
Pre-snapshot foldable candidates must defer folding while their governing snapshot remains young to prevent burial under a pre-snapshot SNAPSHOT written before the governing one ages out.
The fsck --repair-snapshots repair path must enforce the same AUTO_RECOVER vs HUMAN_TRIAGE routing as fsck --repair to prevent policy drift between the two repair doors.
